theater: 天山北麓與交河碎葉草原

battle.name: 唐與西突厥的戰爭
battle.theater: 天山北麓與交河碎葉草原
battle.brief: 640年（貞觀十四年）起，唐朝在交河與天山北麓同西突厥十姓聯盟開戰：先平高昌、置安西都護府於交河，同年冬以李靖為交河道行軍大總管出師；又於諾真水以步軍下馬執長槊正面衝鋒，破了騎兵萬矢齊發。卡面的希臘重步兵並不在西域，其方陣盾牆只能對照唐軍密集結陣、長槊直推的實際戰法。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是七世紀前期唐朝與西突厥聯盟在西域與天山北麓的正面對峙，交戰主體並非兩個國家，而是各自帶著城邦與部族網絡的兩套體系。唐方由太宗李世民主持，軍隊以府兵為骨幹，關內、河東、河南宿衛與折衝府兵臨時集結，另有禁軍，以及歸附唐廷的鐵勒、突厥內附部眾充當嚮導與前鋒，並以西域城邦與羈縻都督府提供補給與基地；作戰序列上設行軍大總管，640年的高昌之役由吏部尚書侯君集任交河行軍大總管、薛萬均任副總管，同年討西突厥則以兵部尚書李靖為交河道行軍大總管，642年安西都護、西州刺史郭孝恪以輕騎在伊州、烏骨、遏索山一線作戰。西突厥一方是阿史那氏為主的十姓聯盟，咥利失可汗分國為十部、各賜一箭，是謂十箭，左右廂分五咄陸與五弩失畢，以碎葉為界東西分牧，置可汗、葉護、俟斤、啜等號，兵以游騎射為主，四處遊牧而少有長久城堡。捲入者還有高昌、焉耆、伊吾、龜茲、鄯善等城邦，以及處月、處密、吐火羅、康居、米國、白水胡城諸部與漠北的薛延陀；雙方之間更有結盟、內應與背叛層層中介。
countriesEn: This war was a direct confrontation in the early seventh century between the Tang court and the Western Turkic coalition across the Western Regions and the northern foot of the Tianshan. The belligerents were not two states but two systems, each carrying its own network of oasis cities and tribal groups. On the Tang side the war was directed by Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin. The field army rested on the fubing levies mustered from the garrisons of Guanzhong, Hedong and Henan, supplemented by the imperial guard and by Iron and Turkic auxiliaries who had submitted to the Tang and served as guides and as an advance guard, while the oasis states and the jimi protectorates supplied bases and provisions. Command was organised through a great general of the marching armies: for the campaign against Gaochang in 640, Hou Junji, minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed great general of the march on the Jiaohe route, with Xue Wanjun as deputy; the expedition against the Western Turks in the same year was led by Li Jing, minister of war, as great general of the march on the Jiaohe route; and in 642 Guo Xiaoke, protector-general of Anxi and governor of Xizhou, fought with light cavalry in the Yizhou, Wugu and Suosuo line. The Western Turks were a ten-tribe alliance under the Ashina. Qielishi the khagan divided his state into ten tribes and gave each one arrow, the so-called ten arrows, then split them into a left and a right wing, the five du-lu and the five nu-shibi, with the herds past Suoyye and those west of it grazing on either side of that seat, and they held the titles of khagan, yabghu, serkïn and choch; their strength was mounted archers on the move, pasturing far and wide and seldom holding permanent fortresses. Others pulled into the conflict were the oasis states of Gaochang, Yanqi, Huyou, Kucha and Shanshan, together with the peoples of Chuyue, Chumi, Tuyuhun, Kangju, the country of Mi and the White Water city, and with Xueyantuo in the desert north. Between the two sides stood layers of alliance, of clientship and of betrayal, each acting as intermediary.
people: 唐方的核心是太宗李世民，他決定發兵、任命行軍大總管並在642年以冊立新可汗的方式分化敵方。兵部尚書李靖任交河道行軍大總管，率大軍深入天山北麓與碎葉一線，是640年討西突厥的主帥；吏部尚書侯君集任交河行軍大總管，639年底至640年征高昌，築巢車、施飛石、逼得高昌出降，也正因他的推進而使西突厥可汗西走；左屯衛大將軍薛萬均為其副總管。阿史那社爾是蘇尼失之子、娶唐宗女，貞觀初封左賢王，並在高昌之役中任行軍總管，641年薛延陀擊西突厥時，他與沙缽羅同在受攻的一方。鐵勒契苾部的契苾何力早已內附，在西域之戰中充嚮導，向唐軍指出險隘與水源；薛仁貴亦以李靖部將身分隨征，記中說他以先鋒之眾破敵立功，斬獲數字各本互異。西突厥方面的關鍵人物是乙毘咄陸可汗，他吞併十姓、囚唐使者、寇伊州、西擊康居，終因部眾不附而西奔吐火羅；沙缽羅葉護可汗即侯利苾，641年受唐冊於雖合水北，旋為石國吐屯所擒殺；乙毘射匱為莫賀咄之子，642年受唐冊立取代咄陸。漠北的薛延陀真珠可汗則是整個北方的另一支力量。
peopleEn: At the centre of the Tang side stood Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin, who decided to send the armies, appointed the great generals of the march, and in 642 broke the enemy by the device of investing a new khagan. Li Jing, minister of war, was made great general of the march on the Jiaohe route and led the main force deep into the northern Tianshan and the Suoyye line in 640. Hou Junji, minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was great general of the march on the Jiaohe route for the expedition against Gaochang from late 639 into 640, where he built siege towers, worked the trebuchets and forced Gaochang to surrender; it was his advance that sent the Western Turkic khagan fleeing west. Xue Wanjun, general of the Left garrison of the palace guards, was his deputy. Ashina She'er, son of Su-nishi and husband of a Tang princess, was made left wise king early in the Zhenguan era and served as a general of the march in the Gaochang campaign; in 641, when Xueyantuo struck the Western Turks, he stood on the attacked side together with Shaboluo. Qiebie Heli of the Iron tribe of Qiebie had already submitted to the Tang and served as guide in the campaigns in the Western Regions, pointing out the passes and the water for the Tang columns. Xue Rengui also campaigned under Li Jing as an officer of the van, the records saying that he broke the enemy with a small advance force and distinguished himself, though the figures for his captures differ from book to book. The key figure on the Western Turkic side was Yipiduluo the khagan, who swallowed up the ten tribes, detained Tang envoys, raided Yizhou, struck west at Kangju, and in the end lost the adherence of his people and fled west to Tuyuhun. Shaboluo Yabghu Khagan, that is Hou Libi, received investiture from the Tang in 641 north of the Suihe river, and was then taken and killed by the tokun of Shiguo. Yipishegui, son of Mohe, was invested by the Tang in 642 in place of Duluo. Xueyantuo Zhenzhu the khagan in the desert north was a second power watching the whole northern frontier.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵，屬於公元前五世紀的希臘密集盾陣步兵：青銅頭盔與胸甲、大圓盾、長矛與短劍，靠盾牌相接互相遮蔽而立足。但這類裝備在七世紀的天山北麓並不存在，青銅圓盾與希臘式方陣在西域既無出土，也無任何編年記載，雙方陣上都沒有它的位置。卡面在此役代表的是「不靠個人武勇、靠隊形互相遮蔽正面」這一軍事原理本身，而它在唐軍身上的實際樣本，就是640年12月諾真水之戰中李世勣所部士卒的做法：騎兵受敵萬矢齊發、戰馬多死，軍中下令「士卒皆下馬，執長槊直前衝之」，以密集長槊正面推進，敵眾遂潰。唐軍的裝備以長槊、方天戟與橫刀為骨幹，重裝用甲騎，輕裝用皮甲與札甲，弩手用擘張弩與床弩，攻城則有填塹、飛石與巢車，640年征高昌時築巢車高十丈，俯瞰城中之處皆有人唱報。唐廷的後勤倚賴馬隊、駱隊運糧與屯田，軍中甲冑、皮條與弓弦的用量極大。西突厥與薛延陀的裝備以皮甲札葉、複合弓、骨鏃箭、長矛標槍、馬具與氈帳為主，控弦之士善於騎射，軍食以肉酪與乳為主；高昌則據城掘溝、備飛石，以逸待勞。
kitsEn: The hoplite on the card belongs to the dense shield-wall infantry of fifth-century Greece: bronze helmets and cuirasses, a large round shield, long spears and short swords, standing by the shield that each man shields his neighbour. But nothing of the kind existed on the northern foot of the Tianshan in the seventh century. Bronze round shields and the Greek phalanx do not appear in the archaeology of the Western Regions, and no chronicle places them on either side of the field. On this card the hoplite stands for the military principle itself, that a line is held not by individual valour but by mutual cover, and the form that principle actually took in the Tang army is recorded at the battle of the Nuozhen river in December 640, in the action of Li Shiji's men: the enemy loosed a volley of arrows and many Tang horses were hit, whereupon the command went out that the soldiers should all dismount, take their long spears and push straight forward, so that a dense spear line advanced and the enemy broke. The Tang equipment of this war rested on long spears, pole-arms with broad blades, and the horizontal sabre; heavy troops fought as armoured cavalry, light troops wore leather and lamellar armour; crossbowmen used handbows and heavy bolt-throwers; the siege train had filling of ditches, stone-throwers and siege towers, and in the campaign against Gaochang in 640 a tower ten zhang high was raised so that every place in the city struck by a stone was called out to the men below. Tang logistics rested on horse and camel trains, on grain and on military farms, and the army consumed leather, hide and bowstrings on a large scale. The equipment of the Western Turks and of Xueyantuo was leather and lamellar armour, composite bows, bone-tipped arrows, long spears and javelins, horse gear and felt tents; their mounted archers were expert with the bow, and their army fed on meat, cheese and milk. Gaochang, for its part, relied on walled towns, ditches and stone-throwers, and on waiting for the enemy to tire.
tactics: 640年的高昌之役是雙方戰法的樣本。高昌王麴文泰算準了唐軍「去我七千里，沙磧居其二千里」，主張「以逸待勞，坐收其弊」；唐軍則不襲其墟墓，鼓行而進至田城，一日而下，遂填塹施飛石、築巢車瞰城。可汗聞訊「懼而西走千餘里」，屯可汗浮圖城的葉護以城降——唐軍的推進同時震動了西域的聯盟。對西突厥的正面作戰，唐廷倚重三招：發兵直趨交河與碎葉，以行軍大總管節制諸道兵；用「下馬執長槊」的密集步兵正面破解騎兵衝擊，諾真水一役即是；同時在敵方聯盟內部製造分裂，642年立乙毘射匱以代乙毘咄陸，即以夷制夷。西突厥一方的戰法則是避免會戰：十姓分牧，遊騎射擾，不與唐軍步騎正面相持，一旦受挫即西走康居、吐火羅；部眾也用反戈回擊首領，胡祿屋襲乙毘咄陸即是一例。追擊則靠輕騎的截擊與奔襲，642年郭孝恪以輕騎二千自烏骨邀擊破敵，追奔至遏索山，拔處月俟斤所居城，降處密之眾。補給線是全場最硬的一條限制：道塗沙磧千里，冬風如割、夏風如焚，平高昌之後每年還要發兵千餘人戍守，遠征的極限由運糧決定。
tacticsEn: The campaign against Gaochang in 640 is the clearest sample of the two styles. The Gaochang king Qu Wentai calculated that the Tang army lay seven thousand li away, with two thousand of them across burning sand, and argued that he would wait at ease and let the enemy wear itself out. The Tang did not fall on his funeral ground, pressed on to the city of Tian, took it within a day, filled the ditches under a hail of stone, and raised a ten-zhang tower to look down into the town. The khagan, on hearing of it, was so frightened that he fled west more than a thousand li, and the yabghu who had been holding the city of Khagan Futu surrendered it. Against the Western Turks the Tang relied on three measures: to send the army straight for the Jiaohe route and Suoyye under a great general of the march, with the contingents of all circuits under one hand; to break the charge of mounted troops with dense infantry dismounted and holding long spears, exactly as at the Nuozhen river; and to split the enemy alliance from within, as in 642 when Yipishegui was invested in place of Yipiduluo, a barbarian turning one barbarian against another. The Western Turks avoided set-piece battle: the ten tribes grazed separately, mounted archers worried the enemy, and they avoided a direct meeting with Tang infantry and cavalry, breaking off to the west towards Kangju and Tuyuhun when pressed. Their own people turned against their khagan, as when Hu Luwu struck at Yipiduluo. Pursuit was the work of light cavalry: in 642 Guo Xiaoke took two thousand light horse to Wugu, ambushed the enemy and beat them, chased them to the Suosuo mountains, took the city where the Chuyue serkïn sat, and brought back the people of Chumi. Supply was the hardest limit in the whole campaign: the road was a thousand li of sand, the winter wind cut like a knife and the summer wind burned like fire, and even after Gaochang fell more than a thousand men had to be sent each year to garrison it. The furthest reach of the expedition was set by the grain trains.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處。641年正月，侯利苾即沙缽羅葉護可汗帥部落濟河，建牙於故定襄城，記有戶三萬、勝兵四萬、馬九萬匹。貞觀十二年，薛延陀真珠可汗建庭於都尉犍山北、獨邏水南，勝兵二十萬，立其二子拔酌、頡利苾分主南北部，唐則以分封二子為小可汗來分其勢。640年12月諾真水之役，薛延陀大度設率眾三萬騎逼長城，唐軍陣亙十里，斬首三千餘級、捕虜五萬餘人；薛延陀眾走至漠北，遇大雪，人畜凍死者什八九。高昌方面，640年唐軍下其二十二城，記戶八千四十六、口一萬七千七百，地東西八百里、南北五百里，俘虜七千餘口，巢車高十丈，築城時飛石落處皆唱報。西突厥的組織數字是十部、各賜一箭，左廂五咄陸置五大啜居碎葉以東，右廂五弩失畢置五大俟斤居碎葉以西，以伊列水為境。編年記載唐國當年州府三百五十八、縣一千五百一十一，平高昌後歲發兵千餘人戍守其地，642年郭孝恪出輕騎二千。李靖出師的兵數，諸本多記為十餘萬。至於640年交河道之戰本身的斬獲與雙方損耗，現存編年多不記載，具體數字不可考，本節只列可核對者。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster in a few places. In the first month of 641 Hou Libi, that is Shaboluo Yabghu Khagan, led his people across the river and established his seat at the old city of Dingxiang, and the record gives three myriad households, forty thousand fighting men and ninety thousand horses. In 638 Xueyantuo Zhenzhu the khagan set his camp north of the Duwei Jian mountains and south of the Duluo river with two hundred thousand fighting men, and set up two sons, Bazhuo and Helibi, to hold the north and the south; the Tang answered by investing both sons as lesser khagans in order to divide his strength. At the battle of the Nuozhen river in December 640 Xueyantuo's Dadashe brought thirty thousand cavalry against the Great Wall, the Tang line was deployed for ten li, and the record gives more than three thousand heads cut off and more than fifty thousand prisoners. The people of Xueyantuo who reached the desert north were caught by heavy snow, and of their men and beasts one in ten or nine in ten perished. Against Gaochang in 640 the Tang took twenty-two cities, and the record gives eight thousand and forty-six households and seventeen thousand seven hundred persons, a country eight hundred li by five hundred, more than seven thousand captives, and a siege tower ten zhang high, with the fall of every stone called out from below. The organisation of the Western Turks is given as ten tribes, each with one arrow, the five du-lu on the left with five choch east of Suoyye, the five nu-shibi on the right with five serkïn west of it, and the Irtysh as the frontier. The annals give three hundred and fifty-eight circuits and one thousand five hundred and eleven counties in the Tang that year, more than a thousand men sent to garrison Gaochang each year afterwards, and two thousand light horse under Guo Xiaoke in 642. The size of Li Jing's army is given in most texts as a hundred thousand men and more. As for the kills and the losses of the 640 campaign on the Jiaohe route itself, the surviving annals record little, and the exact figures cannot be recovered; only the verifiable ones are given here.
cause: 起因是多層的。直接的一層是東突厥在630年被唐打平之後留下的權力真空：漠北與西域一時無主，西突厥以阿史那氏的十姓聯盟佔據伊列水以西的廣闊草原，控弦之眾以百萬計，與唐在高昌、焉耆、伊吾一線的羈縻體系正面接壤，商路、鹽源與牧場的爭奪隨之而來。近因則是高昌：麴文泰斷絕西域朝貢，與西突厥共擊破焉耆，唐使被阻、質問無果，遂有640年的出兵。更早的層面是外交干預：唐在629至639年間已先後冊立西突厥首領、分封薛延陀二子為小可汗以分其勢，使十姓聯盟內部的裂痕愈來愈深。到了640年前後，乙毘咄陸吞併十姓、殺沙缽羅葉護、拘留唐使者、遣兵寇伊州，並遣處月、處密兩部包圍天山，唐已不能只靠羈縻與冊封處理，必須用兵。這正是此役的結構：唐以軍事手段打通西域通道，同時在敵方聯盟內部扶持反對者，以夷制夷與正面出征並行。
causeEn: The causes worked on several levels. The immediate one was the power vacuum left behind when the Eastern Turks were broken by the Tang in 630: with no master in the desert north or the Western Regions, the ten-tribe alliance of the Ashina took the broad pastures west of the Irtysh, numbering its bowmen by the hundred thousand, and came face to face with the Tang jimi system along the Gaochang, Yanqi and Huyou line, so that the caravan roads, the salt and the pastures were all at stake. The proximate occasion was Gaochang. Qu Wentai cut off the tribute of the Western Regions, joined with the Western Turks in breaking Yanqi, kept the Tang envoys away and refused to answer the rebuke sent to him, and there followed the dispatch of troops in 640. Deeper down lay the record of diplomatic interference: between 629 and 639 the Tang had already invested khagans among the Western Turks one after another and had made the two sons of Xueyantuo lesser khagans in order to divide his strength, so that the rift inside the ten-tribe alliance widened. By about 640 Yipiduluo had swallowed the ten tribes, killed Shaboluo Yabghu, detained Tang envoys, sent troops against Yizhou and ringed Tianshan with the Chuyue and Chumi; the Tang could no longer manage matters by investiture and control alone and had to use soldiers. That is the shape of this war: the Tang opened the corridor into the Western Regions by force, while at the same time backing opponents inside the enemy alliance, marching and turning barbarians against barbarians at once.
impact: 最深的一層後果是體制的落地。640年九月，唐以高昌故地為西州、可汗浮圖城為庭州，並置安西都護府於交河城留兵鎮之；西域第一次有了常設的軍事與行政機構，之後安西四鎮的格局即由此起步。代價同樣清楚：平高昌之後每年要發兵千餘人戍守，褚遂良上疏力陳沙磧千里、往來多死，認為得不償失；唐廷不聽，說明帝國已經把西域視為不可放手的邊防，而不是可有可無的屬地。第二層後果在草原上：642年白水胡城之役後，乙毘咄陸失去諸部擁護，西奔吐火羅，弩失畢諸部與屋利啜等請廢之以立乙毘射匱，而唐廷順勢冊立新可汗，於是十姓聯盟內部的分裂成為常態，西突厥此後還有車鼻、賀魯一波波抗唐，直到647年與657年才被分別平定，唐廷才設昆陵、濛池都護府。第三層是軍事學上的：這幾年證實了長槊密集步兵可以正面破騎兵萬矢，也證實了遠征的極限由運糧與屯田決定，這兩條經驗後來成為安西都護府作戰的底子。
impactEn: The deepest consequence was institutional. In the ninth month of 640 the Tang made the old lands of Gaochang into Xizhou, the city of Khagan Futu into Tingzhou, and established the protectorate general to pacify the West at the city of Jiaohe, leaving a garrison there. For the first time the Western Regions had a standing military and administrative institution, and the later pattern of the four garrisons of Anxi grew out of it. The cost was equally clear: after the fall of Gaochang more than a thousand men had to be sent to garrison it every year, and Chu Suiliang memorialised the court that the road was a thousand li of sand, that travellers died constantly on it, and that the gain was not worth the cost; the court refused him, which shows that the empire had already decided the Western Regions were a frontier to be held rather than a possession to be let go. The second consequence lay on the steppe. After the fighting at the White Water city in 642, Yipiduluo lost the adherence of the tribes and fled west to Tuyuhun; the nu-shibi and Wulichuo and the others asked that he be deposed and Yipishegui set up in his place, and the Tang investiture followed, so that division inside the ten-tribe alliance became the normal condition, with Chebi and Helu still to rise in revolt afterwards, until the years 647 and 657 brought their defeats in turn and the Tang set up the protectorates of Kunling and Mengchi. The third consequence was military in kind: these years proved that dense infantry with long spears could break a volley of arrows head on, and also proved that the reach of a distant campaign was set by grain and by military farms. Both lessons became the foundation of how the Anxi protectorate fought.
result: 就640年起的這一段而言，結果要分層看。第一層是唐在西域的收穫：侯君集所部平高昌，置西州、庭州與安西都護府於交河；西突厥可汗聞唐兵至而西走千餘里，屯可汗浮圖城的葉護以城降。第二層是641至642年唐對西突厥的連續得分：沙缽羅葉護可汗受冊於雖合水北，乙毘咄陸殺之而自為強，又囚唐使、寇伊州，唐以郭孝恪輕騎二千自烏骨邀擊破之，拔處月俟斤所居城，降處密之眾；乙毘咄陸西擊康居、破米國而內部生變，白水胡城一役之後諸部反戈，他自保白水胡城終至西奔吐火羅，弩失畢諸部改立乙毘射匱。第三層是西突厥並未因此覆亡：聯盟只是從統一轉為分裂，可汗一個接一個被冊立又被推翻，抗唐的戰火一直延續到647年車鼻可汗被擒與657年蘇定方平賀魯、設昆陵與濛池都護府為止，那兩場屬於同一場長戰爭的後段。對唐而言，這幾年換來的是西域通道與常設邊防，付出的是年年出兵與遠道運糧；對西突厥而言，則是從草原強權跌為受唐冊立與左右、只能靠內部爭奪尋找生路的聯盟。
resultEn: For the stretch that begins in 640 the results have to be read in layers. The first is what the Tang gained in the Western Regions: the force under Hou Junji brought down Gaochang, and Xizhou, Tingzhou and the protectorate general to pacify the West were set up at Jiaohe; the Western Turkic khagan, on hearing that Tang troops were coming, fled west more than a thousand li, and the yabghu holding the city of Khagan Futu surrendered it. The second layer is the run of Tang successes against the Western Turks in 641 and 642: Shaboluo Yabghu Khagan received investiture north of the Suihe river, Yipiduluo killed him and grew strong in his place, detained Tang envoys and raided Yizhou, and the Tang answered with two thousand light horse under Guo Xiaoke striking them by ambush from Wugu, taking the city of the Chuyue serkïn and bringing in the people of Chumi; Yipiduluo struck west at Kangju and broke the country of Mi, and his own people turned against him, and after the fighting at the White Water city the tribes rose against him, he shut himself up in that city, and finally fled west to Tuyuhun, while the nu-shibi set up Yipishegui in his place. The third layer is that the Western Turks were not destroyed by any of this. The alliance simply passed from unity to division, one khagan after another was invested and then overthrown, and the war of resistance ran on until Chebi was taken in 647 and Su Dingfang beat Helu in 657, when the protectorates of Kunling and Mengchi were established; those two belong to the later phase of the same long war. For the Tang these years bought a corridor into the Western Regions and a standing frontier, and cost annual dispatch and grain carried over long distances. For the Western Turks they meant the fall from a steppe power to an alliance kept in place by Tang investiture, able to look for survival only in its own internal quarrels.
